provenance.selection: every entry with mode 0, kem_id 16, kdf_id 1 and aead_id 2; that is entry 9 (zero-based) of 24, copied unchanged
provenance.format: The Go file keeps the RFC 9180 test-vector members for keys and enc and replaces the per-encryption list with accumulated values. encryptions_accumulated is the first 16 octets of SHAKE128 over the concatenated ciphertexts of 1000 Seal calls on one sender context, at sequence numbers 0 to 999. Each call draws aad and then pt from one SHAKE128 stream over empty input; each draw reads one length octet n and then n octets. Go 1.27.0 src/crypto/hpke/hpke_test.go, testVectors and drawRandomInput, defines this procedure.
provenance.exports: exports_accumulated is copied but not checked: this profile computes no exporter output.
